key_insight: MFF-Agent combines LLM reasoning with Rocq verification in a unified workflow for formalizing diverse mathematical foundations.
engineering_relevance: Its classify–execute–verify workflow offers a reusable architecture for AI-assisted formalization with tool feedback and explicit task-state tracking.
method: Classify formalization tasks and manage their execution state.
Use LLM reasoning and tools to generate and refine formal proofs.
Use Rocq verification feedback to guide revisions.
evidence_signal: Case studies cover Morse–Kelley set theory, real numbers, propositional logic, and axiom-of-choice equivalences, distinguishing source completion, interactive verification, and reproducible compilation.
watch_item: The abstract reports feasibility rather than quantitative performance, and a unified workflow does not establish a fully integrated mathematical foundation.
paper_title: Math Foundation Formalization Agent: A General-Purpose Approach to Formalizing Mathematical Foundations
